description: GoogleSQL constructs with the most favourable compatibility each may receive. Levels come from GoogleSQL semantics, not from converter output.

cases.sql: SELECT order_id, amount FROM `p.sales.orders` WHERE amount > 10
SELECT * FROM `p.logs.events_*` WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20260131'
SELECT * EXCEPT (secret) FROM `p.sales.customers`
SELECT * FROM EXTERNAL_QUERY('p.us.pg', 'SELECT id FROM accounts')
SELECT NET.HOST(url) AS host FROM `p.web.hits`
SELECT ST_DISTANCE(a, b) AS d FROM `p.geo.points`
SELECT SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', raw) AS d FROM `p.sales.raw`
SELECT SAFE_CAST(raw AS INT64) AS n FROM `p.sales.raw`
SELECT o.order_id, i.sku FROM `p.sales.orders` o, UNNEST(o.items) AS i
SELECT id FROM `p.sales.a` WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM `p.sales.b`)
MERGE INTO `p.sales.t` T USING `p.sales.s` S ON T.id = S.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET v = S.v WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id, v) VALUES (S.id, S.v)
SELECT * FROM `p.sales.orders` TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM (10 PERCENT)
SELECT DATE_ADD(order_date, INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS due FROM `p.sales.orders`
SELECT id, ts FROM `p.sales.events` QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY ts DESC) = 1
SELECT * FROM `p.sales.orders` FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR)
DECLARE cutoff DATE DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE(); SET cutoff = DATE_SUB(cutoff, INTERVAL 1 DAY); SELECT * FROM `p.sales.orders` WHERE order_date = cutoff
DECLARE i INT64 DEFAULT 0; WHILE i < 3 DO SET i = i + 1; END WHILE
BEGIN SELECT 1/0; EXCEPTION WHEN ERROR THEN SELECT @@error.message; END
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `p.sales.' || table_name || '`'
